description: K₂NaTbCl₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. K is bonded to twelve equivalent Cl atoms to form distorted KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent TbCl₆ octahedra. All K-Cl bond lengths are 3.80 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TbCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.74 Å. Tb is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form TbCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Tb-Cl bond lengths are 2.64 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Tb atom.
